code:
# Alarm on a per-instance metric, default TreatMissingData
#
# Instance terminates in a scale-in event
# -> metric stops reporting
# -> "missing" default can leave ALARM state in place
#    even though nothing is actually wrong
#
# Fix: set TreatMissingData explicitly
# (notBreaching | breaching | ignore | missing)
caption: The wrong TreatMissingData setting turns a routine scaling event into a page.

code:
ALARM("high-p99-latency") AND ALARM("elevated-5xx-rate")

# and, to suppress noise during planned deploys:
ALARM("elevated-5xx-rate") AND NOT ALARM("deployment-in-progress")
caption: Combines other alarms' states with AND/OR/NOT — requires corroborating evidence before paging.
